content: Feature recommendation based on the requested product scope and established file-import/dashboard conventions: support multi-file FIT upload, per-file progress/result, isolated failures, duplicate and skipped non-run explanations, and retryable actionable errors; show a six-week current-week-inclusive view with totals, weekly trend, newest-first runs, observed-only partial windows, and unavailable rather than zero for missing optional metrics; run detail should expose headline metrics, an interactive track map when GPS exists, available distance/time-indexed charts, and laps when present, while absent GPS, HR, cadence, or laps must not break the page. Exact competitor UI behavior was not independently verified in this run.
